name: Hiiragi Tatsuki
source:
1st-year High School student. Member of the Art Club.

Although his physique is similar to that of an athlete, he's part of the cultural department. He has a gentle personality and is a little shy, but he's still very fond of Kanade, who he met at the entrance ceremony.

[From [url=http://honeyapple.html.xdomain.jp/game01/chara.html]official website[/url]]
